children: CID HoldCo completed the acquisition of Envoy in a stock deal valued at approximately $65 million at a $6.00 reference price, issuing common and Series C preferred shares. The company also executed several companion agreements to align conversion, registration and voting mechanics, including amending the purchase agreement and Envoy convertible note, adding Blink via a joinder, granting registration rights, and securing voting support from key holders. These steps are intended to facilitate post-closing share conversions, meet Nasdaq requirements, and provide resale liquidity for recipients.
Agreement 1: CID HoldCo Closes Envoy Acquisition in $65 Million Stock Deal; Amends Purchase Terms
: Amended securities purchase agreement for acquisition of Envoy
: Close Envoy deal and align Blink note conversion and distribution
Agreement 2: CID HoldCo Adds Blink Under Limited Joinder to Enforce Conversion and Distribution Terms
: Limited joinder and acknowledgement to purchase agreement
: Bind Blink to conversion and distribution obligations
Agreement 3: CID HoldCo, Blink Amend Envoy Convertible Note to Defer and Align Share Conversion
: First amendment to Envoy convertible promissory note
: Align note conversion with post-closing approvals and registration
Agreement 4: CID HoldCo Grants BladeRanger, Blink, H Capital Registration Rights for Envoy Deal Shares
: Registration rights agreement for resale of Envoy deal securities
: BladeRanger; Blink Charging; H Capital Ventures Management Consultancies Co.
: Until resale completion or Rule 144 eligibility
: Provide liquidity path for transaction-related securities
Agreement 5: CID HoldCo Secures Voting Support From Key Holders for Nasdaq and Conversion Approvals
: Voting agreement securing approvals for conversions and Nasdaq rules
: Phyllis W. Newhouse; ShoulderUp 2021 Trust; Edmund S. Nabrotzky
: Until Stockholder Approval or agreement termination
: Facilitate required stockholder approvals for conversions and listing compliance
